"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

-- Read-only observations of original firmware. No guest writes or forced events.
local json=require('json')
local machine=manager.machine
local cpu=machine.devices[':maincpu']
local p,r=cpu.spaces['program'],cpu.spaces['register']
local ram,banks
for name,index in pairs(machine.devices[':'].items) do
 if name:match('/m_banked_ram$') then ram=emu.item(index) end
 if name:match('/m_bank_regs$') then banks=emu.item(index) end
end
assert(ram and ram.count==0x100000 and banks)
local folder=assert(os.getenv('BS1_OBSERVER_DIR'))
local log=assert(io.open(folder..'/observations.jsonl','w'))
local inspecting=false
local function word(a) return banks:read(a-0x100)|(banks:read(a-0xff)<<8) end
local function physical(a,fetch) return (word((fetch and 0x100 or 0x108)+2*(a>>14))<<10)+(a&0x3fff) end
local function raw(a,n)
 local out={}
 for i=0,n-1 do
  local x=physical((a+i)&0xffff,false)
  if x>=ram.count then return nil end
  out[#out+1]=string.format('%02x',ram:read(x))
 end
 return table.concat(out)
end
local function context(kind)
 local row={kind=kind,seconds=machine.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,psw=cpu.state['PSW'].value,selectors={},registers={}}
 for a=0x100,0x10e,2 do row.selectors[string.format('%04x',a)]=word(a) end
 for _,a in ipairs({0x18,0x1c,0x1e,0x28,0x2a,0x2c,0x2e,0x42,0x48,0x4a,0x4c,0x4e,0x58,0xb8,0xba,0xbc,0xbe,0xda}) do row.registers[string.format('%02x',a)]=r:read_u16(a) end
 row.physical_pc=physical(row.pc,true)
 row.stack=raw(r:read_u16(0x18),16)
 row.target_state=raw(0x3620,0x30)
 row.descriptor=raw(r:read_u16(0x48),16)
 return row
end
local function emit(row) log:write(json.stringify(row)..'\n');log:flush() end
local call_count=0
local returns={}
local examples={}
local taps={}
-- Tap handles remove themselves at Lua garbage collection; retain the handles.
_G.bs1_observer_taps=taps
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x102,0x103,'bs1-call',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local before=word(0x102)
 local sp=r:read_u16(0x18)
 local target=r:read_u16(0x1e)
 local entry=d==0x3b and target>=0x73d6 and target<0x8000 and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce22
 local returning=before==0x3b and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce36 and returns[sp]
 if entry or returning then
  -- POP increments SP before the selector write tap fires: all 12 saved
  -- bytes are already popped when CE36 is observed.
  if entry then returns[sp+12]=target else target=returns[sp];returns[sp]=nil end
  call_count=call_count+1
  inspecting=true
  local row=context('selector-write');row.before=before;row.value=d;row.routine=target;row.direction=entry and 'entry' or 'return'
  if entry and target==0x7592 then
   local ptr=r:read_u16(0x48)
   if ptr>=0x4000 and ptr<0x8000 then
    row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page=ram:read_block((0x2cc<<10)+(ptr&0x3fff),16):gsub('.',function(c) return string.format('%02x',string.byte(c)) end)
   end
  end
  local key=string.format('%04x-%s-%s',target,row.direction,(row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page or ''):sub(1,4))
  examples[key]=(examples[key] or 0)+1
  if examples[key]<=12 then emit(row) end
  inspecting=false
 end
end)
local commands=0
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0xe404,0xe405,'bs1-spc-control',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting or physical(a,false)~=0x102404 then return end
 commands=commands+1
 if commands<=2000 then
  inspecting=true local row=context('spc-control');row.value=d;row.mask=m;emit(row);inspecting=false
 end
end)
local ranges={{0x03d3e,0x05c80},{0xdabe4,0xe435c},{0xe435e,0xe7c00},{0xe8010,0xec000},{0xec000,0xed338},{0xed3f8,0xf0000},{0xf53d4,0xfc000},{0xfc000,0x100000}}
local writes={}
for i=1,#ranges do writes[i]={count=0,first={}} end
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x120,0xffff,'bs1-candidate-writes',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local x=physical(a,false)
 for i,range in ipairs(ranges) do
  if x>=range[1] and x<range[2] then
   local w=writes[i];w.count=w.count+1
   if #w.first<8 then w.first[#w.first+1]={address=a,physical=x,data=d,mask=m,pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,fetch_page=word(0x100+2*(cpu.state['CURPC'].value>>14)),seconds=machine.time:as_double()} end
   break
  end
 end
end)
local seen=''
local candidate_reads={count=0,first={}}
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_read_tap(0x120,0xffff,'bs1-candidate-reads',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local x=physical(a,false)
 if x>=0x3d3e and x<0x5c80 then
  candidate_reads.count=candidate_reads.count+1
  if #candidate_reads.first<16 then
   candidate_reads.first[#candidate_reads.first+1]={address=a,physical=x,data=d,mask=m,pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,fetch_page=word(0x100+2*(cpu.state['CURPC'].value>>14)),seconds=machine.time:as_double()}
  end
 end
end)
emu.register_periodic(function()

 if not f then return end
 local tag=f:read('*a');f:close()
 if tag==seen or not tag:match('^[%w_-]+$') then return end
 seen=tag;inspecting=true
 local out=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.ram','wb'));out:write(ram:read_block(0,ram.count));out:close()
 local row=context('snapshot');row.tag=tag;row.ranges=ranges;row.cpu_writes=writes;row.call_count=call_count;row.spc_controls=commands;row.candidate_data_reads=candidate_reads;row.timer1=r:read_u16(0x0a);emit(row)
 local done=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.json','w'));done:write(json.stringify(row));done:close()
 inspecting=false
end)
emit({kind='observer-ready',ram_bytes=ram.count,qualification='Read-only save-item snapshots and passthrough CPU write taps. CPU write counts exclude direct DMA; snapshot differences include DMA. No access absence proves ownership.'})

"""Design arithmetic only: not a guest transport or a hardware timing test."""
import json

U32_MAX = (1 << 32) - 1

class Budget:
    def __init__(self, timer, total_limit, idle_limit, poll_limit):
        assert 0 < total_limit <= U32_MAX and 0 < idle_limit <= U32_MAX
        assert poll_limit > 0
        self.previous = timer
        self.total = self.idle = self.polls = 0
        self.total_limit, self.idle_limit, self.poll_limit = total_limit, idle_limit, poll_limit

    def sample(self, timer, progress=False):
        delta = (timer - self.previous) & 0xffff
        self.previous = timer
        self.total = min(U32_MAX, self.total + delta)
        self.idle = min(U32_MAX, self.idle + delta)
        self.polls += 1
        # Check expiry before allowing a late progress event to reset inactivity.
        if self.total >= self.total_limit:
            return 'total-expired'
        if self.idle >= self.idle_limit:
            return 'idle-expired'
        if self.polls >= self.poll_limit:
            return 'poll-limit'
        if progress:
            self.idle = 0
        return 'continue'

def validate():
    results = []
    b = Budget(0xfff0, 1000, 1000, 100)
    assert b.sample(0x10) == 'continue' and b.total == 32
    results.append(dict(case='single-wrap', observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(0, 200000, 200000, 100)
    for actual in [50000, 100000, 150000]:
        assert b.sample(actual & 0xffff) == 'continue'
    assert b.total == 150000
    results.append(dict(case='multiple-wraps-with-frequent-sampling', observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(0, 100000, 100000, 100)
    assert b.sample(65535) == 'continue' and b.total == 65535
    results.append(dict(case='largest-unambiguous-delta', observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(0, 400, 150, 100)
    for now in [100, 200, 300]:
        assert b.sample(now, progress=True) == 'continue'
    assert b.sample(400, progress=True) == 'total-expired'
    results.append(dict(case='progress-does-not-renew-total-deadline', polls=b.polls, observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(123, 1000, 1000, 8)
    for _ in range(7):
        assert b.sample(123, progress=True) == 'continue'
    assert b.sample(123, progress=True) == 'poll-limit' and b.total == 0
    results.append(dict(case='stalled-clock-and-progress-still-have-finite-poll-bound', polls=b.polls))
    b = Budget(0, 1000, 500, 100)
    assert b.sample(500, progress=True) == 'idle-expired'
    results.append(dict(case='late-progress-cannot-erase-inactivity-expiry', observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(0, U32_MAX, U32_MAX, 100)
    b.total = U32_MAX - 10
    assert b.sample(20) == 'total-expired' and b.total == U32_MAX
    results.append(dict(case='saturating-32-bit-total', observed_ticks=b.total))
    b = Budget(0, 1000, 1000, 100)
    assert b.sample(65536 & 0xffff) == 'continue' and b.total == 0
    results.append(dict(case='known-limit-an-entire-unsampled-wrap-is-invisible', actual_ticks=65536, observed_ticks=b.total, qualification='Expected counterexample; requires a qualified maximum sampling gap.'))
    return results

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(dict(qualification=__doc__, cases=validate()), indent=2))

"""Retain marker lifetime, Save System, TIMER1 and recovery-contract evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections, hashlib, importlib.metadata, json, re, struct
import numpy as np
import pypcode
from deadline_model import validate as validate_deadlines

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SAVE, COLD = HERE/'marker-save-01', HERE/'marker-cold-01'

def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def u16(b, a): return struct.unpack_from('<H', b, a)[0]

original = (ROOT/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
assert digest(original) == '3827ed4c46fd48abbec3095266164853033141d7bd15afe8dda0050d00e073cd'
assert original == (ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
marker_image = (HERE/'marker-os.img').read_bytes()
marker = bytes(1 + ((i*73 + 0x35) % 251) for i in range(8002))
assert original[0x853e:0xa480] == bytes(8002)
assert marker_image == original[:0x853e] + marker + original[0xa480:]
saved_image = (SAVE/'saved-system.img').read_bytes()
assert len(saved_image) == len(original) == 1474560
assert saved_image[0x853e:0xa480] == marker
save_differences = [i for i, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(saved_image,marker_image)) if a != b]
assert save_differences and not any(0x853e <= i < 0xa480 for i in save_differences)

runs, snapshots = [], []
for folder, count in [(SAVE,7),(COLD,4)]:
    run = json.loads((folder/'result.json').read_text())
    assert run['source_unchanged']
    assert all(sha(ROOT/p) == h for p,h in run['identities'].items())
    runs.append(dict(name=folder.name, report=run, commands={p.name:json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(folder.glob('command-*.json'))}, screenshot_sha256={p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted(folder.glob('*.png'))}))
    paths = sorted((folder/'runtime/bs1-observer').glob('frame-*.json'))
    assert len(paths) == count
    for p in paths:
        context = json.loads(p.read_text())
        ram = p.with_suffix('.ram').read_bytes()
        assert len(ram) == 1048576 and ram[0x3d3e:0x5c80] == marker
        assert context['candidate_data_reads']['count'] == 0
        assert context['cpu_writes'][0]['count'] == 0
        lo = context['selectors']['0108'] << 10
        snapshots.append(dict(run=folder.name, tag=p.stem, ram_sha256=sha(p.with_suffix('.ram')), marker_sha256=digest(ram[0x3d3e:0x5c80]), raw_context=context, allocation_cursor=u16(ram,lo+0x3616), public_samples_hex=[ram[0xd2800:0xd2830].hex(),ram[0xd2830:0xd2860].hex()], partial255_refs=[u16(ram,0xd2790),u16(ram,0xd27a0)]))
assert snapshots[-3]['partial255_refs'] == [65535,65535]
assert all(x['partial255_refs'] == [512,513] for x in snapshots[-2:])
assert all(x['allocation_cursor'] == 26 for x in snapshots[-3:])
assert all(x['public_samples_hex'] == snapshots[-3]['public_samples_hex'] for x in snapshots[-2:])

# Retain raw timer rows, then check guest-instruction observations independently
# of periodic callbacks (which can be between scheduler and CPU timeslices).
log_path = COLD/'runtime/bs1-observer/observations.jsonl'
observations = [json.loads(line) for line in log_path.read_text().splitlines()]
timer_sets = {}
for kind, count in [('timer1-read',512),('timer1-periodic',1024)]:
    rows = [r for r in observations if r['kind'] == kind]
    assert len(rows) == count and all(r['wsr'] == 0 for r in rows)
    pairs = [dict(actual_interval_us=(b['seconds']-a['seconds'])*1e6, timer_delta=(b['data']-a['data'])&65535) for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:])]
    assert all(0 < x['actual_interval_us'] < 65536 for x in pairs)
    max_error = max(abs(x['timer_delta']-x['actual_interval_us']) for x in pairs)
    assert max_error < (1 if kind == 'timer1-read' else 46)
    if kind == 'timer1-read':
        assert all(r['mask'] == 65535 for r in rows)
        assert all(r['data'] == (int(r['seconds']*1e6) & 65535) for r in rows)
    timer_sets[kind] = dict(rows=rows, count=len(rows), interrupts_masked_observations=sum(not (r['psw']&0x200) for r in rows), pc_counts=dict(collections.Counter(f"{r['pc']:04X}" for r in rows)), observed_rollovers=sum(b['data'] < a['data'] for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:])), min_interval_us=min(x['actual_interval_us'] for x in pairs), max_interval_us=max(x['actual_interval_us'] for x in pairs), max_interval_error_us=max_error)

# Verify annotations against the immutable original, not the marker bytes.
static = []
for name, ranges in [('frontier_p4b_794a.asm',None),('timer_isr.asm',None),('os_handoff_and_interrupts.asm',[(0x4800,0x483f),(0x4e50,0x4e60)]),('resident_services.asm',[(0xa480,0xa49d)])]:
    p = ROOT/'firmware_source/os_disk/src'/name
    anchors = []
    for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
        m = re.search(r'\[([0-9A-Fa-f]{6}): ([0-9A-Fa-f ]+)\]',line)
        if not m: continue
        offset, raw = int(m[1],16), bytes.fromhex(m[2])
        if ranges is not None and not any(lo <= offset < hi for lo,hi in ranges): continue
        assert original[offset:offset+len(raw)] == raw
        anchors.append(dict(file_offset=offset, bytes=raw.hex(), instruction=line.split(';')[0].strip()))
    assert anchors
    static.append(dict(source=str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha(p), selected_file_ranges=ranges, anchors=anchors))

ctx = pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
decoded = []
for page, first, end in [(0,0xfd20,0xfd3e),(0x4b,0x7a18,0x7a1f),(0x3b,0x7e31,0x7ef8)]:
    offset = 0x4800+(page<<10)+(first&0x3fff)
    ins = ctx.disassemble(original[offset:offset+end-first],base_address=first).instructions
    assert ins[-1].addr.offset+ins[-1].length == end
    decoded.append(dict(page=page, first=first, end_exclusive=end, instructions=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset, file_offset=offset+i.addr.offset-first, bytes=original[offset+i.addr.offset-first:offset+i.addr.offset-first+i.length].hex(), text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in ins]))

# Recheck all allocation bytes and a common source position for stereo audio.
fixture = ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-feasibility-2026-10-18/stereo-04/captured-stereo.img'
disk, wave = fixture.read_bytes(), (COLD/'wave.bin').read_bytes()
assert wave[16:16+239616] == disk[0x2ac00:0x2ac00+239616]
audio = np.fromfile(COLD/'stereo.pcm',dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2)
tail = np.fromfile(COLD/'tail.pcm',dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2)
assert np.isfinite(audio).all() and np.isfinite(tail).all()
assert not np.array_equal(audio[:,0],audio[:,1]) and not np.any(tail[-44100:])
pcm, fits = [], []
for channel,(period,step) in enumerate([(257,64),(509,32)]):
    raw = wave[16+channel*119808:16+(channel+1)*119808]
    source = np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2')[:56719].astype(float)
    initial_phase = int(source[0])//step + period//2
    assert np.array_equal(source,((np.arange(56719)+initial_phase)%period-period//2)*step)
    assert not any(raw[56719*2:])
    y = audio[5000:30000,channel].astype(float)
    best = None
    for phase in range(period):
        x = ((np.arange(len(y))+phase)%period-period//2)*step
        gain = float(np.dot(y,x)/np.dot(x,x))
        error = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y-gain*x)**2)/np.mean(y*y)))
        if best is None or error < best['relative_rms_error']:
            best = dict(output_channel=channel, source_channel=channel, phase=phase, gain=gain, relative_rms_error=error)
    assert best['relative_rms_error'] < 1e-6
    fits.append(best)
    pcm.append(dict(channel=channel, frames=56719, allocation_bytes=119808, sha256=digest(raw), period=period, step=step, initial_phase=initial_phase))
common = [n for n in range(56719-25000+1) if all((pcm[c]['initial_phase']+n)%pcm[c]['period'] == fits[c]['phase'] for c in range(2))]
assert len(common) == 1

source_names = ['native_save_system.py','native_cold_verify.py','probe_base.py','probe_base_timer.py','observer.lua','observer_timer.lua','deadline_model.py',Path(__file__).name]
identity_paths = [ROOT/'mame-source/src/devices/cpu/mcs96'/n for n in ['i8x9x.cpp','mcs96.cpp','mcs96.h']]
identity_paths += [ROOT/'mame-source/src/mame/roland/s760.cpp',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua']
report = dict(date='2026-10-18',status='BS1 IN PROGRESS; data-marker persistence qualified for retained workflows; no extension storage reservation or bounded transport implementation', versions={n:importlib.metadata.version(n) for n in ['numpy','Pillow','pypcode']},
    marker=dict(physical_start=0x3d3e,physical_end_exclusive=0x5c80,file_start=0x853e,file_end_exclusive=0xa480,bytes=8002,original_fill=0,formula='1 + ((index * 73 + 0x35) % 251)',sha256=digest(marker),image_sha256=digest(marker_image),changed_byte_count=8002,all_changes_confined_to_candidate=True,proposed_fetch_mapping=dict(selector_0102=15,logical_start=0x413e,logical_end_exclusive=0x6080),startup_clear_physical=[0x81120,0x82120],qualification='Data marker only. No new executable instructions or guest state forcing.'),
    save_system=dict(image_sha256=digest(saved_image),bytes=len(saved_image),header_hex=saved_image[:32].hex(),candidate_exact=True,difference_count_from_marker_image=len(save_differences),difference_spans_bounds=[min(save_differences),max(save_differences)+1],qualification='Native Save System formatted and wrote a private blank floppy through ordinary controls. Other saved bytes differ; this is not whole-image equality.'),
    runs=runs,snapshots=snapshots,timer=dict(nominal_clock_hz=16000000,cycles_per_tick=16,tick_us=1,wrap_ticks=65536,psw_interrupt_enable_mask=0x200,observations=timer_sets,log_sha256=sha(log_path),qualification='Guest reads follow machine-time microseconds in this build. Periodic callback reads show up to 45 us phase skew; do not claim submicrosecond periodic or physical accuracy. Masked observations are not a duration bound for all critical regions.'),
    deadline_design_checks=validate_deadlines(),static=static,decoded=decoded,
    stereo=dict(fixture_sha256=sha(fixture),exact_allocation_bytes=239616,pcm=pcm,audio_sha256=sha(COLD/'stereo.pcm'),tail_sha256=sha(COLD/'tail.pcm'),frames=len(audio),fits=fits,common_source_frame_for_analysis_window=common,final_second_silent=True),
    source_identities={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in identity_paths},sources={n:(HERE/n).read_text() for n in source_names},
    external_primary_sources=[dict(url='https://www.syndex.org/kernels/196/27065103.pdf',title='Intel 80C196KB User Guide 270651-003',sections=['1.3','7.1','7.4'],accessed='2026-10-18'),dict(url='https://ftp.netbsd.org/pub/NetBSD/NetBSD-release-10/src/sys/dev/ic/mb89352reg.h',title='NetBSD MB89352 register definitions',accessed='2026-10-18'),dict(url='https://ftp.netbsd.org/pub/NetBSD/NetBSD-release-10/src/sys/dev/ic/mb89352.c',title='NetBSD MB89352 driver',accessed='2026-10-18')],
    limitations=['CPU data taps exclude instruction fetch and direct DMA. No observed accesses is not proof of non-use.','Save System copies the candidate; mutable workspace must be initialized on every boot/entry rather than trusting saved bytes.','Only Mouse+CRT, 32 MiB, stock executable instructions and retained workflows are exercised.
